experiment: ACID EXTREME - Option A: Reduced budget (50 gens, pop 10)

rpa.note: One block does NOT help. 0/10 found.

rpa_rpa.note: TWO blocks together DO help. 4/10 found vs 1/10 random.

verdict_detail: Two blocks together (RPA+RPA) improve discovery reliability from 1/10 to 4/10 when search budget is severely limited (50 gens, pop 10). One block alone (RPA) does NOT help (0/10). The composition of TWO blocks provides the critical mass needed to seed the search space with useful partial solutions.
key_findings: With 50 gens x pop 10, random search FAILS 9/10 times on sum_6
One block (RPA) does NOT help: 0/10 found
Two blocks (RPA+RPA) DO help: 4/10 found (4x improvement)
The improvement is in RELIABILITY, not speed
Blocks only help when search budget is severely limited
With sufficient budget (500 gens), blocks are unnecessary

50_gens_pop_10.conclusion: search budget insufficient, two blocks help

final_conclusion: Blocks provide value ONLY when the search budget is insufficient for evolution to find the solution independently. With two composed blocks, reliability improves from 10% to 40%. This is the first POSITIVE result for blocks in the ACID experiment.
